rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.003, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=zeros, rationale=iter-15 INIT-scheme probe. PWLS confirmed INERT: iter-14 (gamma=0, plain TV) hr=0.35965550 vs iter-9 (gamma=1, Manhart) hr=0.35964474 differ at the 7th sig-digit (dHR~1.1e-7) -> Manhart ray-weight has no measurable effect on breast at any regime (TV term dominates data residual). PWLS-negative confirmed (matches Mayo). Only plain-TV knobs remain; tv_init untested. ONE knob: tv_init fbp->zeros at best config (gamma=1, lambda=3e-3, 1000it, gd, lr=0.01, decay=0.01). HYPOTHESIS: FBP init warm-starts GD near the data-consistent solution; zeros forces reconstruction from scratch in 1000 iters. If hr drops, FBP warm-start is essential (expected for TV-GD); if hr matches, GD is fully converged and init-agnostic at 1000 iters. Budget: ~868s at 1000 iters, <1200s wall.
